descriptions.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]轨道上检测到了不明来源舰体的遗骸。
descriptions.en: Sensors report a shipwreck of unidentified origin has been sighted in orbit of [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器在[Root.GetName]轨道上检测到了不明来源舰体的遗骸。
sections.en: Sensors report a shipwreck of unidentified origin has been sighted in orbit of [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
descriptions.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

sections.zh: 虽然[From.GetName]这颗星球上缺乏大气，但地表上有人造设施的遗迹，说明过去这里曾有文明。
sections.en: Despite the planet's lack of atmosphere, there is evidence of some kind of artificial structures on [From.GetName] that may indicate a past civilization.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]周围的吸积盘呈现出绚丽的折射光谱，与彩虹的无异。造成这种现象的原因会是什么？
descriptions.en: The accretion disk around [From.GetName] exhibits a remarkable refraction spectrum, not unlike that of a rainbow. What could be causing it?

sections.zh: [From.GetName]周围的吸积盘呈现出绚丽的折射光谱，与彩虹的无异。造成这种现象的原因会是什么？
sections.en: The accretion disk around [From.GetName] exhibits a remarkable refraction spectrum, not unlike that of a rainbow. What could be causing it?

descriptions.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]的轨道上有未知舰队，我们向他们发出联络，但他们没有回复。
descriptions.en: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.

sections.zh: 我们发现[From.GetName]的轨道上有未知舰队，我们向他们发出联络，但他们没有回复。
sections.en: Readings suggest the presence of an unknown fleet in orbit of [From.GetName]. They do not respond to hails.

descriptions.zh: 探测器发现在[From.GetName]的地表有着异常高的对称性。
descriptions.en: Scanners indicate an unusually high level of symmetry on the surface of [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 探测器发现在[From.GetName]的地表有着异常高的对称性。
sections.en: Scanners indicate an unusually high level of symmetry on the surface of [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]这个行星体的表面覆盖着某种灰色物质，该灰色物质拥有十分怪异的性质和复杂多变的金属成分。
descriptions.en: The planetary body [From.GetName] appears to be covered in some manner of grayish substance, possessing strange properties and varying metallic composition.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]这个行星体的表面覆盖着某种灰色物质，该灰色物质拥有十分怪异的性质和复杂多变的金属成分。
sections.en: The planetary body [From.GetName] appears to be covered in some manner of grayish substance, possessing strange properties and varying metallic composition.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。
descriptions.en: Highly irregular gravitational readings surround [From.GetName].

sections.zh: [From.GetName]周围有着高度异常的重力读数。
sections.en: Highly irregular gravitational readings surround [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现有东西在移动，好像是一艘舰船在云层中高速穿梭。
descriptions.en: There is movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName], as though a ship was gliding hurriedly through the clouds.

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现有东西在移动，好像是一艘舰船在云层中高速穿梭。
sections.en: There is movement in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName], as though a ship was gliding hurriedly through the clouds.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]的近距离轨道上发现不明舰体的碎片。
descriptions.en: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]的近距离轨道上发现不明舰体的碎片。
sections.en: There are fragments of an unknown vessel in close orbit of [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
descriptions.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

sections.zh: 对废弃的环形世界[From.GetName]的初步成像显示出在某些毁坏的区段上有着大量完好无损的舱体。这些舱体里装载的东西未知是什么。
sections.en: Initial imaging of the ruined [From.GetName] ring world indicates a number of intact vats located on some of the dilapidated sections. Whatever these vats might hold is unknown.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]小行星的共振成像显示其内部含有稀有水晶。
descriptions.en: Resonance imaging of the [From.GetName] asteroid suggests an internal composition consisting of rare crystals.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]小行星的共振成像显示其内部含有稀有水晶。
sections.en: Resonance imaging of the [From.GetName] asteroid suggests an internal composition consisting of rare crystals.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]具有显著的非球面特征，其地表有着巨大且完全不符合地理学模型的构造。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]具有显著的非球面特征，其地表有着巨大且完全不符合地理学模型的构造。
sections.en: [From.GetName] is remarkably aspherical, possessing some sort of enormous formation on its surface that defies geological models.

descriptions.zh: 从某个未知源点发散的网状结构在[From.GetName]的表面周期性发光。
descriptions.en: Glowing webs of an unknown origin periodically illuminate the surface of [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 从某个未知源点发散的网状结构在[From.GetName]的表面周期性发光。
sections.en: Glowing webs of an unknown origin periodically illuminate the surface of [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的发射光谱表明这颗气态巨行星的主要构成成分拥有和某种流行的酒类饮料相同的分子结构。
descriptions.en: The emission spectra of [From.GetName] suggest the gas giant's primary composition has the same molecular structure as a popular inebriant.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的发射光谱表明这颗气态巨行星的主要构成成分拥有和某种流行的酒类饮料相同的分子结构。
sections.en: The emission spectra of [From.GetName] suggest the gas giant's primary composition has the same molecular structure as a popular inebriant.

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行扫描后发现该星球地壳中有不少共鸣水晶，我们应该能对此加以利用。
descriptions.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal a continental crust filled with resonant crystals. We may be able to make some use of them.

sections.zh: 对[From.GetName]进行扫描后发现该星球地壳中有不少共鸣水晶，我们应该能对此加以利用。
sections.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal a continental crust filled with resonant crystals. We may be able to make some use of them.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的磁层对我们的研究用无人机产生了强大的吸引力，原因不明。我们应该进行进一步的调查。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName]'s magnetosphere is highly appealing to our research drones in orbit, for reasons they cannot explain. We should investigate further.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的磁层对我们的研究用无人机产生了强大的吸引力，原因不明。我们应该进行进一步的调查。
sections.en: [From.GetName]'s magnetosphere is highly appealing to our research drones in orbit, for reasons they cannot explain. We should investigate further.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的地表上覆盖了一层非常奇特的植物，这与该星球上的其他植物都不相同。
descriptions.en: Entire continents on [From.GetName] are blanketed in a strange growth that seems at odds with the rest of the planet's flora.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的地表上覆盖了一层非常奇特的植物，这与该星球上的其他植物都不相同。
sections.en: Entire continents on [From.GetName] are blanketed in a strange growth that seems at odds with the rest of the planet's flora.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的地表是冻土，但测量到的表面温度却高达上百度，是什么造成了这种不一致的现象呢？
descriptions.en: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的地表是冻土，但测量到的表面温度却高达上百度，是什么造成了这种不一致的现象呢？
sections.en: The measured surface temperature of [From.GetName] is in the hundreds of degrees, despite its frozen surface. What could be causing these discrepancies?

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的大气将我们的传感器在无线电频段的扫描全数反射。在这下方有着什么东西在持续干扰我们的信号。
descriptions.en: The atmosphere of [From.GetName] is reflecting our sensors at radio frequencies. Something down there is interfering with our signals.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的大气将我们的传感器在无线电频段的扫描全数反射。在这下方有着什么东西在持续干扰我们的信号。
sections.en: The atmosphere of [From.GetName] is reflecting our sensors at radio frequencies. Something down there is interfering with our signals.

descriptions.zh: 扫描显示在[From.GetName]的水层之下隐藏着一个错综复杂的隧道系统。是谁创造了它们？
descriptions.en: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?

sections.zh: 扫描显示在[From.GetName]的水层之下隐藏着一个错综复杂的隧道系统。是谁创造了它们？
sections.en: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?

descriptions.zh: 一座荒废的空间站悬浮在轨道上，无力地环绕着[From.GetName]，身披数个世纪里被残骸冲撞而留下的伤痕。考虑到它破损的状态和无法识别的科技，我们需要一个专家团队来对它进行调查。
descriptions.en: Scarred by centuries of debris impacts, a dilapidated relic of a station hangs in orbit, trailing wearily behind [From.GetName]. Its decrepit state and unrecognized technology will require a team of specialists to investigate.

sections.zh: 一座荒废的空间站悬浮在轨道上，无力地环绕着[From.GetName]，身披数个世纪里被残骸冲撞而留下的伤痕。考虑到它破损的状态和无法识别的科技，我们需要一个专家团队来对它进行调查。
sections.en: Scarred by centuries of debris impacts, a dilapidated relic of a station hangs in orbit, trailing wearily behind [From.GetName]. Its decrepit state and unrecognized technology will require a team of specialists to investigate.

descriptions.zh: 这些在[From.GetName]遍布灰尘的地表上勉强度日的土著和我们在同一个星系的另一个死寂星球上发现的物种具有惊人的相似性。
descriptions.en: The primitives eking out an existence on the ashy plains of [From.GetName] are remarkably similar to the ones discovered on another tomb world in the same system.

sections.zh: 这些在[From.GetName]遍布灰尘的地表上勉强度日的土著和我们在同一个星系的另一个死寂星球上发现的物种具有惊人的相似性。
sections.en: The primitives eking out an existence on the ashy plains of [From.GetName] are remarkably similar to the ones discovered on another tomb world in the same system.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的脉冲十分稳定，其日震研究表明它的内部构成物质的密度比我们所预计要大得多。是什么赋予了它这种令人惊异的密度？
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] pulses steadily, its helioseismology indicating an internal composition far denser than expected. What could be responsible for this surprising density?

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的脉冲十分稳定，其日震研究表明它的内部构成物质的密度比我们所预计要大得多。是什么赋予了它这种令人惊异的密度？
sections.en: [From.GetName] pulses steadily, its helioseismology indicating an internal composition far denser than expected. What could be responsible for this surprising density?

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]地表上有许多火山口喷出热气，这对于熔融星球来说是不常见的，部分喷出的热气有较高的工业价值。
descriptions.en: A remarkable array of gases are being vented on [From.GetName] - ones not usually found on molten worlds. Some of these gases show promising industrial value.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]地表上有许多火山口喷出热气，这对于熔融星球来说是不常见的，部分喷出的热气有较高的工业价值。
sections.en: A remarkable array of gases are being vented on [From.GetName] - ones not usually found on molten worlds. Some of these gases show promising industrial value.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的内部扫描图像表明星球地表之下有非常巨大的地下洞窟，它们可能值得调查。
descriptions.en: Interior imaging of [From.GetName] suggests massive underground caverns wait below the planet's surface. They may be worth investigation.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的内部扫描图像表明星球地表之下有非常巨大的地下洞窟，它们可能值得调查。
sections.en: Interior imaging of [From.GetName] suggests massive underground caverns wait below the planet's surface. They may be worth investigation.

descriptions.zh: 一些人工构造从[From.GetName]的剧毒云层中挺立而出。
descriptions.en: Some manner of artificial structure peaks out from between the toxic clouds of [From.GetName]'s atmosphere.

sections.zh: 一些人工构造从[From.GetName]的剧毒云层中挺立而出。
sections.en: Some manner of artificial structure peaks out from between the toxic clouds of [From.GetName]'s atmosphere.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的扫描结果标示了一些被土著居民抛弃的聚落。在聚落的建造者身上究竟发生了什么事情？
descriptions.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal what appear to be the abandoned settlements of a primitive society. What manner of fate could have befallen their builders?

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的扫描结果标示了一些被土著居民抛弃的聚落。在聚落的建造者身上究竟发生了什么事情？
sections.en: Scans of [From.GetName] reveal what appear to be the abandoned settlements of a primitive society. What manner of fate could have befallen their builders?

descriptions.zh: 深到能从轨道直接进行观察的峡谷勾勒出了[From.GetName]表面的纹路，但是这颗行星却像风沙侵蚀区一样干燥。曾经如此强烈地侵蚀了[From.GetName]岩层的那些水怎么了呢？
descriptions.en: Canyons deep enough to be seen from orbit furrow the surface of [From.GetName], yet the planet is dry as a dustbowl. What could have happened to the water that once so profoundly carved [From.GetName]'s' stone?

sections.zh: 深到能从轨道直接进行观察的峡谷勾勒出了[From.GetName]表面的纹路，但是这颗行星却像风沙侵蚀区一样干燥。曾经如此强烈地侵蚀了[From.GetName]岩层的那些水怎么了呢？
sections.en: Canyons deep enough to be seen from orbit furrow the surface of [From.GetName], yet the planet is dry as a dustbowl. What could have happened to the water that once so profoundly carved [From.GetName]'s' stone?

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的植物数量多到惊人地充斥了整个地表，这些植物体积庞大且拥有鲜艳的颜色，我们的异星生物学家对此很感兴趣。
descriptions.en: Plant life of truly incredible proportions dominates the landscape of [From.GetName], its vibrant colors and gargantuan size almost calling to our xeno-biologists.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的植物数量多到惊人地充斥了整个地表，这些植物体积庞大且拥有鲜艳的颜色，我们的异星生物学家对此很感兴趣。
sections.en: Plant life of truly incredible proportions dominates the landscape of [From.GetName], its vibrant colors and gargantuan size almost calling to our xeno-biologists.

descriptions.zh: 有种不同寻常的东西，仿佛催眠了[From.GetName]上海洋的潮起潮落一般。海洋的运动模式与我们目前所知的所有潮汐行为均不相同。
descriptions.en: There is something unusual, almost hypnotic about the soft undulations of the sea covering [From.GetName]. Its motions match no known projections for tidal behavior.

sections.zh: 有种不同寻常的东西，仿佛催眠了[From.GetName]上海洋的潮起潮落一般。海洋的运动模式与我们目前所知的所有潮汐行为均不相同。
sections.en: There is something unusual, almost hypnotic about the soft undulations of the sea covering [From.GetName]. Its motions match no known projections for tidal behavior.

descriptions.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]上有一个孤立的针状人工结构。
descriptions.en: Sensors indicate an isolated pinprick of artificial structures on [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]上有一个孤立的针状人工结构。
sections.en: Sensors indicate an isolated pinprick of artificial structures on [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的初步调查显示了该行星是某个亡故帝国的旧都，我们之前遇到的垃圾场正是属于这个帝国的。对其进行更彻底的调查或许能获得更多的信息。
descriptions.en: Our initial survey of the [From.GetName] suggests this planet is the fallen capital of a lost empire whose junkyards we have encountered prior. A more thorough investigation may yield further information.

sections.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]的初步调查显示了该行星是某个亡故帝国的旧都，我们之前遇到的垃圾场正是属于这个帝国的。对其进行更彻底的调查或许能获得更多的信息。
sections.en: Our initial survey of the [From.GetName] suggests this planet is the fallen capital of a lost empire whose junkyards we have encountered prior. A more thorough investigation may yield further information.

descriptions.zh: 一个来源不明的箱体围绕着[From.GetName]旋转，其中大量贮藏了某种有机物质。
descriptions.en: A derelict tanker of unknown origin orbits [From.GetName], its reservoirs heavy with some manner of organic substance.

sections.zh: 一个来源不明的箱体围绕着[From.GetName]旋转，其中大量贮藏了某种有机物质。
sections.en: A derelict tanker of unknown origin orbits [From.GetName], its reservoirs heavy with some manner of organic substance.

descriptions.zh: 一群静止的吊舱环绕着[From.GetName]，我们开始时以为这是个小行星带。
descriptions.en: First thought to be asteroids, a halo of motionless drop pods surrounds [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 一群静止的吊舱环绕着[From.GetName]，我们开始时以为这是个小行星带。
sections.en: First thought to be asteroids, a halo of motionless drop pods surrounds [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]附近有非常奇特的能源信号，好像整个星球都在时隐时现一样。
descriptions.en: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]附近有非常奇特的能源信号，好像整个星球都在时隐时现一样。
sections.en: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.

descriptions.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
descriptions.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器显示在[From.GetName]厚密的植被之下埋藏着人工构造。
sections.en: Sensors indicate there are artificial formations buried beneath rich vegetation on [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 舰船传感器在[From.GetStarName]星系检测到了一种无法解释的信号干扰模式。
descriptions.en: Ship sensors are picking up an unexplained pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] System.

sections.zh: 舰船传感器在[From.GetStarName]星系检测到了一种无法解释的信号干扰模式。
sections.en: Ship sensors are picking up an unexplained pattern of interference in the [From.GetStarName] System.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]星系的小行星群，靠近[From.GetName]的地方定位了一个反射了我们传感器信号的物体。通过肉眼观察发现该物体具有多边形外形，但因为缺乏扫描数据，我们对它所知甚少。
descriptions.en: An object that reflects our sensors has been located in the [From.GetStarName] asteroid field, near [From.GetName]. Visual observation has identified the object as polygonal in shape, but due to lack of scanner data, little else is known.

sections.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]星系的小行星群，靠近[From.GetName]的地方定位了一个反射了我们传感器信号的物体。通过肉眼观察发现该物体具有多边形外形，但因为缺乏扫描数据，我们对它所知甚少。
sections.en: An object that reflects our sensors has been located in the [From.GetStarName] asteroid field, near [From.GetName]. Visual observation has identified the object as polygonal in shape, but due to lack of scanner data, little else is known.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的地表被某种银色的巨型金属晶体所支配了，这种晶体的体积十分巨大，前所未见。从轨道上看，很像是摩天大楼，有必要接近调查下。
descriptions.en: The geoscape of [From.GetName] is dominated by what appear from orbit to be silvery, metallic crystals of dimensions never-before-seen. From orbit, they eerily resemble skyscrapers. Closer study is warranted.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的地表被某种银色的巨型金属晶体所支配了，这种晶体的体积十分巨大，前所未见。从轨道上看，很像是摩天大楼，有必要接近调查下。
sections.en: The geoscape of [From.GetName] is dominated by what appear from orbit to be silvery, metallic crystals of dimensions never-before-seen. From orbit, they eerily resemble skyscrapers. Closer study is warranted.

descriptions.zh: 扫描发现[From.GetName]的沙丘主要由罕见的颗粒状金属构成，里面可能含有非常珍贵的资源，我们应该提取出来纳为己用。
descriptions.en: Scanners indicate the sandy dunes of [From.GetName] are almost entirely composed of granulate rare metals. Perhaps some valuable resources could be extracted from them.

sections.zh: 扫描发现[From.GetName]的沙丘主要由罕见的颗粒状金属构成，里面可能含有非常珍贵的资源，我们应该提取出来纳为己用。
sections.en: Scanners indicate the sandy dunes of [From.GetName] are almost entirely composed of granulate rare metals. Perhaps some valuable resources could be extracted from them.

descriptions.zh: 和预想的不同，[From.GetName]的厚厚的大气层之下有着一个异常巨大的坚固内核，我们的科学家建议对此进行深入调查。
descriptions.en: Despite expected projections, [From.GetName] has a particularly large solid core beneath its incredibly thick mantle of unique gases. Our scientists recommend further investigation.

sections.zh: 和预想的不同，[From.GetName]的厚厚的大气层之下有着一个异常巨大的坚固内核，我们的科学家建议对此进行深入调查。
sections.en: Despite expected projections, [From.GetName] has a particularly large solid core beneath its incredibly thick mantle of unique gases. Our scientists recommend further investigation.

descriptions.zh: 一座巨大的远古船骸围绕[From.GetName]漂浮。
descriptions.en: A massive shipwreck of ancient design circles [From.GetName].

sections.zh: 一座巨大的远古船骸围绕[From.GetName]漂浮。
sections.en: A massive shipwreck of ancient design circles [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 一个废弃外星平台正围绕一颗恒星漫无目的地漂浮。仔细研究或许可以揭示其作用。
descriptions.en: A defective platform of alien design is drifting aimlessly around a star. Perhaps closer study could reveal its purpose.

descriptions.zh: 一座破旧的观测站围绕着[big_rip_planet.GetName]旋转，但地表上并没有智慧生命存在的迹象。进一步调查或许可以得知原因。
descriptions.en: A tattered old observation post circles [big_rip_planet.GetName] but there are no signs of intelligent life on its surface. Closer investigation may give us the answer to why.

descriptions.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
descriptions.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
sections.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
descriptions.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

sections.zh: 传感器报告[Root.GetName]周围的重重废墟中可能存在有趣的东西。
sections.en: Sensors report a number of possible points of interest within the dense debris field surrounding [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们的探测器在[Root.GetName]上侦测到了表明外星人活动迹象的能源放射。
descriptions.en: Our sensors are registering energy emissions indicative of alien activity on [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [From.System.GetName]星系中有什么东西在损坏我们的探测器数据。这一异常现象的原因似乎是[From.GetName]星球。
descriptions.en: Something in the [From.System.GetName] system is corrupting some of our sensory data. The source of the irregularity seems to be the planet [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们的探测器发现[From.GetName]的能源放射规律存在异常。
descriptions.en: Our sensors indicate odd irregularities in [From.GetName]'s energy emission pattern.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的地表上出现了奇怪的图案，从太空中都可以明显观察到。
descriptions.en: Strange patterns, clearly visible even from space, are forming across the surface of [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 异常读数表明，这座荒凉的星球或许不只是表面上看起来那样而已。
descriptions.en: Unusual readings suggest there may be more to this desolate world than meets the eye.

descriptions.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的初步探测读数表明它可以支持外星生命。
descriptions.en: Initial sensory readings from [From.GetName] suggest it could support alien life.

descriptions.zh: 这颗卫星有些不太寻常。
descriptions.en: There is something unusual about this moon.

descriptions.zh: 出于未知的原因，[Root.GetName]笼罩在一道不可穿透的护盾内，而且护盾正在开裂。
descriptions.en: For reasons unknown [Root.GetName] has been enclosed within an impenetrable shield and the shield is cracking.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]在初步扫描后发现一艘全副武装的舰船正位于小行星带的轨道中，我们必须小心行事。
descriptions.en: Preliminary scans of [From.GetName] indicate that a heavily-armed vessel is in orbit of the asteroid. It would be wise to proceed with caution.

descriptions.zh: 我们碰巧收到来自[From.GetName]上的某个地方的加密讯息。
descriptions.en: We have come upon an encrypted datastream transmitting from a location on [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]的初步扫描结果表明，其内部含有大量致密的精加工金属，也许是某种机械或其他科技。若要获得更多细节数据，则需进行进一步扫描。
descriptions.en: Initial scans of the asteroid [From.GetName] suggest a dense mass of wrought metal within it, perhaps part of some machinery or other technology. Further scanning required for more detailed data.

sections.zh: 对[From.GetName]的初步扫描结果表明，其内部含有大量致密的精加工金属，也许是某种机械或其他科技。若要获得更多细节数据，则需进行进一步扫描。
sections.en: Initial scans of the asteroid [From.GetName] suggest a dense mass of wrought metal within it, perhaps part of some machinery or other technology. Further scanning required for more detailed data.

descriptions.zh: 在对有毒星球[From.GetName]的调查中发现了意料之外的生命迹象。虽然迹象并不明显，但意义非凡。
descriptions.en: Unexpected life signs have been encountered on survey of the toxic planet [From.GetName]. Small, but significant.

sections.zh: 在对有毒星球[From.GetName]的调查中发现了意料之外的生命迹象。虽然迹象并不明显，但意义非凡。
sections.en: Unexpected life signs have been encountered on survey of the toxic planet [From.GetName]. Small, but significant.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]表面发现了类似舰船的物体，且周围散落着小块金属。遗迹似乎没有生命迹象，但却依旧有能源读数反应。
descriptions.en: Bits and pieces of metal are strewn across [From.GetName]'s surface, encircling what looks like the hulk of a ship. The wreckage appears deserted, but energy readings remain.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]表面发现了类似舰船的物体，且周围散落着小块金属。遗迹似乎没有生命迹象，但却依旧有能源读数反应。
sections.en: Bits and pieces of metal are strewn across [From.GetName]'s surface, encircling what looks like the hulk of a ship. The wreckage appears deserted, but energy readings remain.

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
descriptions.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

sections.zh: 对[From.GetName]的光学扫描中，在其部分表面发现了类似小屋的建筑结构，证明此处之前可能有生物居住。
sections.en: Optical scans of the planet [From.GetName] have revealed small hut-like structures littering parts of its surface, suggesting it is inhabited.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面坐落着一座类似大型机器的物体，其来源与功用尚未查明。
descriptions.en: On the surface of [From.GetName] sits what appears to be a large machine, of unknown origin and purpose.

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面坐落着一座类似大型机器的物体，其来源与功用尚未查明。
sections.en: On the surface of [From.GetName] sits what appears to be a large machine, of unknown origin and purpose.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
descriptions.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]的轨道俘获了一个小型未知物体，其正以难以置信的高速移动。
sections.en: Caught in an orbit around [From.GetName] is a small, unknown object moving at such a high speed it beggars belief.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了未知的现象。该现象正导致光线频繁折射，有时甚至被完全遮蔽。
descriptions.en: An unknown phenomenon has been discovered near [From.GetName]. It is causing light to be frequently refracted and occasionally even entirely blocked out.

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近发现了未知的现象。该现象正导致光线频繁折射，有时甚至被完全遮蔽。
sections.en: An unknown phenomenon has been discovered near [From.GetName]. It is causing light to be frequently refracted and occasionally even entirely blocked out.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
descriptions.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].

sections.zh: [From.GetName]荒芜的地表上传来一道奇特的能源信号。
sections.en: A strange energy signature emanates from the barren and lifeless surface of [From.GetName].
